$comment: Rules for scripts/docs/check-prose.ts. A `ban` is wrong every time it appears and an exception needs an allow entry stating the fact that makes it one. A `budget` is per-file DEBT that may only fall: above the entry fails, below it also fails, and `--ratchet` prints the corrected map. Each rewrite deletes its files' entries; when the map empties, the rule becomes a ban and the map goes away. Cadence measures the style guide leaves to a person (sentence length, `rather than`, bold labels, forced triples) are deliberately absent and printed by --report instead.

rules.hint: Rewrite it away: move a list behind a colon, split the sentence, or use a comma or parentheses. See docs/extending/contributing/docs.md.
An en dash between numbers or key names is a range and is allowed. Anywhere else, rewrite it.
Use straight quotes. Curly ones arrive from a word processor, not from this repo.
No decorative emoji. A glyph the app itself draws is a UI label and needs an allow entry saying so.

rules.regex: I hope this helps|Let me know if|Would you like me to|Certainly!|Great question|You're absolutely right|without further ado|Here's what you need to know
rules.hint: Chatbot framing left in the page. Delete it.
Negative parallelism ("it's not just X, it's Y") is the most-cited AI structure there is. State the claim directly.
An essay-shaped section heading. Say what the section is about instead.

rules.regex: \b(delve|delves|delving|seamless|seamlessly|comprehensive|holistic|intricate|intricacies|cutting-edge|groundbreaking|transformative|tapestry|testament|pivotal|crucial|vital|realm|landscape|underscore|underscores|underscoring|showcases|showcasing)\b|(?<![-\w])robust\b|\bshed light\b|\bpave the way\b|\bat its core\b|\bworth noting\b|\bin order to\b|\bdue to the fact\b|\bhas the ability to\b|\bwhen it comes to\b|\blet's (dive|explore|break)\b|\bleverag(e|es|ing|ed)\s|\bfoster(s|ing|ed)?\s+(a|an|the)\b
rules.hint: A word AI writing reaches for far more often than people do. Say the plain thing.
